t: What Clinical Guideline Change Database Is All About
title: What Clinical Guideline Change Database Is All About
description: Clinical guidelines change as evidence accumulates: aspirin for primary prevention was routine, then trials showed bleeding outweighed benefit for most (USPSTF 2022: don't start after 60). Mammography start ages, cholesterol targets, and hypertension thresholds (130/80 since 2017) all moved. GRADE rates evidence quality; strong recommendations need strong evidence. Tracking changes shows medicine correcting itself. Reference information, not medical advice. This database is the complete guideline change: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
